set.name: Tideglass Reach
set.theme: A drowned archipelago where volcanic glass grows out of the tide like coral. Storm-priests read the weather in its facets, reef-clans harvest it for blades, and something older is waking under the deepest shelf. Flavour is coastal, weathered and elemental: salt, obsidian, kelp, thunderheads, and creatures shaped by pressure and current.

cards.name: Reefclan Harpooner
cards.flavorText: The reef teaches patience before it teaches anything else. A harpoon thrown in haste feeds nothing but the current.

cards.name: Glasswing Scout
cards.flavorText: Nothing crosses the Reach in a straight line. The glass throws the wind back at itself.
